output.summary: A perennial herb widespread across much of North and South America, swamp smartweed grows in saturated or flooded places and is sometimes semi-aquatic. It spreads by underground stems, may root from lower stem joints and bears spikes of small pinkish flowers. It is reported to be edible and, according to at least one author, lacks the pungency of close relatives.
